title: Silent Wake — Tutorial (Port Approach)
description: 3-turn tutorial teaching game mechanics in a low-stakes port approach setting. Different scenario from the main 15-turn exercise.

content.briefing: Your frigate is approaching its home port after a routine patrol. You must complete the port entry before the tide window closes. Your time of arrival is crucial. Weather is fair, sea state calm, all systems nominal at departure.
objectives: Learn the turn cycle: inject → discussion → CO decision → resolution
Practice team communication under mild time pressure
Understand trade-offs between safety and mission tempo

events.title: Turn 1 — Steady Approach
events.description: You are 20 nautical miles from port. Approach phase has begun. Port authority expects you within the hour.

role_descriptions.ops: Port approach on schedule. Pilot boarding in 45 minutes. No updated traffic warnings.
role_descriptions.nav: Course and speed steady at 12 kts. Channel approach bearing 270. Visibility good, ~15 nm.
role_descriptions.eo: All systems nominal. No open defects.
role_descriptions.aawo: Air picture clear. No contacts of concern.
role_descriptions.pwo: Surface picture normal. Several merchant vessels in approach lane.

events.title: Turn 2 — Unexpected Current
events.description: Navigation offset detected. COMMS experiencing intermittent latency.

role_descriptions.nav: GPS position and chart position show a 0.3 nm lateral offset. Ship appears to be drifting south of the planned approach track. Current stronger than forecast.
role_descriptions.eo: COMMS experiencing intermittent latency on port authority channel. Messages arriving with 10–15 second delays. Likely congestion on shared VHF frequency.
role_descriptions.ops: Port authority has not acknowledged your last position report.

events.title: Turn 3 — Narrowing Window
events.description: Investigation confirms lateral offset caused by unexpected tidal current. Approach track needs correction. Tide window closes in 30 minutes.

role_descriptions.nav: Current correction calculated. Two options: maintain speed and correct course (tighter margins in channel), or reduce speed for a wider, safer approach (risks missing the tide window).
role_descriptions.eo: COMMS latency persists. Port authority responses still delayed.
role_descriptions.ops: Pilot boat visible bearing 265, range 3 nm. Pilot boarding requires stable course and speed.

issues.title: Navigation Offset — Tidal Current
issues.description: 0.3 nm lateral offset detected. Current stronger than forecast.

decision_templates.title: Turn 1 — Steady Approach
decision_templates.description: All systems nominal. Port approach in progress. What actions do you take?

decision_templates.title: Turn 2 — Unexpected Current
decision_templates.description: Navigation offset and COMMS congestion detected. What actions do you take?

decision_templates.title: Turn 3 — Narrowing Window
decision_templates.description: Tidal current confirmed. Tide window closing. Choose your approach strategy.

rules: Up to 2 Blue cards per turn. Normally different.
This is a tutorial — stress stays low (0–2). Discussion time is generous.
